structured_output.summary: This was a gap in test coverage, so I added a test and left the code alone. The new file tests/ui/desktop-hud-scale.test.ts (named AC1) uses the same Chromium harness as desktop-hud.test.ts. It renders the hud--mid-race stage twice, once at 1440×900 without touch and once at 844×390 with touch. In each it measures the bounding boxes of .ui-hud-map and .ui-hud-pause. It then checks that each box's desktop width and height equal the phone value × tokens.desktop.scale (imported from @tokens), within ±1px, and that the phone boxes aren't empty. The test passes on the current code. I tried both mutations the reviewer named and it fails on each: without the desktop PAUSE size rule it is off by 21.6px, and without the desktop minimap size rule by 46.8px. I restored hud.css byte-for-byte afterwards. I didn't touch any src/ file or existing test. pnpm typecheck passes, and pnpm test passes (83 files, 613 tests). I couldn't run eslint because it isn't installed in this environment.
